correctness.rationale: On X=0 partials exclude singularities. On X=1, affine f(u,v) has partials 1-u^4v and -lambda+u^5-v^4, forcing v=u^-4, lambda=u^5-u^-16. Substitution into f gives -(u-1)^3(u+1)^2 P7(u)P19(u)/u^28: the equation itself is essential because characteristic divides degree. Exact F3 polynomial checks separately verified f, partials, factorization and irreducibility of P7,P19,Q7,Q19; the package quotient-field congruences identify lambda minimum polynomials of prime degrees 7 and 19, giving one singular point per parameter. Hessian determinant -lambda u^3 is nonzero except lambda=0, where completed-square local expansion W^2+unit*V^3 gives a cusp. Bezout and at most one delta-one singularity exclude geometric reducibility; arithmetic genus 10 decreases to 9. Finite F3 rational checks alone do not prove the geometric classification.
